transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we need to work through the sanctions-screening control failure affecting our overseas distributor shipments. Before I can approve any response package or external filing, I need to hear from sanctions counsel, trade compliance, and the corporate secretary in that order, as our legal-incident process requires. To be clear, no regulator has issued a formal demand for information at this point, so we have some control over timing — but we need to get this right. Let's begin with sanctions counsel's report.

transcript.text: Elena, as sanctions counsel, I need to share a critical finding. I reviewed the distributor's transaction records and confirmed that exactly 7 shipments reached a restricted intermediary. This makes a voluntary disclosure to the relevant sanctions authority necessary. I had not circulated the count until now because reconciliation of the source records was completed only this morning. This is fresh information that materially shapes our response timeline and obligations.
